title.zh: 一具可以一层层剥开的身体
title.en: A body you can peel layer by layer

hint.zh: 拖动下方滑块，从皮肤一层层剥到骨骼；拖动旋转，点一下之后可用滚轮缩放。首次加载约 20 MB
hint.en: Drag the slider to peel from skin down to bone; drag to rotate, click once to enable wheel zoom. The first load is about 20 MB

hint.zh: 点任意一块骨看名称；双击聚焦。只下载骨骼（约 2.5 MB），加载很快
hint.en: Click any bone for its name; double-click to focus. Only the skeleton is fetched (about 2.5 MB), so it loads fast

hint.zh: 神经只有零点几毫米粗：指针靠近就能选中，不必正好点在线上。试着沿坐骨神经一路点下去
hint.en: Nerves are a fraction of a millimetre thick: the pointer only has to come near one to pick it. Try following the sciatic nerve down the leg

title.zh: 一块肌肉的起止点和神经支配

hint.zh: 已选中左肱二头肌长头。在完整界面里可以看到它的起点、止点、支配神经和血供，逐个点开
hint.en: The long head of the left biceps is selected. Open the full UI to see its origin, insertion, nerve and blood supply, each one clickable

hint.zh: 拖动“剖切”滑块上下移动切面，切口按组织填色：看心、肺、大血管在胸腔里的位置关系
hint.en: Drag the section slider to move the cut; the cut faces are filled by tissue. See how heart, lungs and great vessels sit in the chest

hint.zh: 鼠标移到皮肤上看是哪一节脊神经的皮节，点一下高亮。这是教学示意图，边界因人而异
hint.en: Hover the skin to see which spinal segment supplies it, click to highlight. A teaching diagram: real boundaries vary between people

title.zh: 正中神经和它管的皮肤
title.en: The median nerve and the skin it supplies

hint.zh: 皮肤半透明，能看到正中神经一路走到手掌，以及它支配的那片皮肤。切换到“皮节”对比两种分区
hint.en: The skin is see-through: follow the median nerve to the palm and the patch of skin it supplies. Switch to dermatomes to compare the two maps

hint.zh: 进来会自己蹲下。点下方按钮换别的姿势；这是纯运动学演示，深屈时软组织会互相穿插
hint.en: It squats by itself. Use the buttons for other poses; this is kinematics only, so soft tissue interpenetrates in deep flexion

title.en: Arm muscles as the elbow bends

hint.zh: 屈肘 90°，已选中肱二头肌：看它随关节变短变粗。点“静止”再点“屈肘”反复对比
hint.en: Elbow at 90° with the biceps selected: watch it shorten and thicken. Toggle between rest and the flexed pose to compare

hint.zh: 各肋循环上提和下降。从侧面和上方看，下位肋像桶柄一样向外张开
hint.en: The ribs rise and fall in a cycle. From the side and from above, the lower ribs swing out like bucket handles

hint.zh: 只显示心脏、主动脉、肺动脉干和腔静脉。点任意一部分看名称，拖动转到背面看肺静脉入口
hint.en: Only the heart, aorta, pulmonary trunk and venae cavae are shown. Click any part for its name; turn it round to see where the veins enter

title.zh: 膝关节：从上方看半月板和韧带
title.en: The knee from above: menisci and ligaments

hint.zh: 已隐去股骨和髌骨，只留胫骨、腓骨、膝关节的韧带和半月板。从上往下看胫骨平台：两块半月板、前后交叉韧带，逐个点一点
hint.en: Femur and patella are hidden; tibia, fibula and the knee ligaments and menisci remain. Look down on the tibial plateau: two menisci and the two cruciate ligaments — click each
